# Values and notifications by printer

<!-- Generated by tests/gen_values.py; don't edit by hand. -->

Which notifications a printer can send, and which template values have data on it: ✅ yes, ➖ only with Spoolman, ❌ no (the value reads `n/a`). *Other* is any Klipper printer with Moonraker and no profile of its own; its values depend on its hardware (shown: a single-extruder printer with a heated bed, a bed mesh and Z tilt). `printer.*` values are Klipper's own and exist wherever the printer has that object.

## Notifications

| Notification | Snapmaker U1 | Creality Hi | Other Klipper printers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Print started (`started`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Pre-print calibrations finished (`preprint_done`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Print paused (`paused`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Print resumed (`resumed`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| First layer started (`layer_started`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Layer complete (`first_layer`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Progress (`progress`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Status report (`status_report`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Print complete (`complete`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Print cancelled (`cancelled`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Bed cooled (`bed_cooled`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| From macros and G-code (`macro`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Manual calibrations (`calibration`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Filament loaded / unloaded (`filament_change`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Not enough filament (`filament_short`) | ➖ Spoolman | ➖ Spoolman | ➖ Spoolman |
| Spool running low (`filament_low`) | ➖ Spoolman | ➖ Spoolman | ➖ Spoolman |
| Switched to backup spool (`spool_switch`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Spool in ACE slot ran out (`slot_empty`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Waiting for chamber temperature (`chamber_waiting`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Reached chamber temperature (`chamber_reached`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Chamber faults (`chamber_fault`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Error (`error`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Warning (`warning`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Klipper shutdown (`shutdown`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Power loss recovery (`power_loss`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Driver running hot (`driver_hot`) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
